simplemusic.guide.page.1.title: Simple Music
simplemusic.guide.page.1: Write sheet music as text, listen to it in the editor and let the Orchestrion play it on a loop. Burn your own mono Ogg files onto blank discs.
simplemusic.guide.page.2.title: Sheet Music
simplemusic.guide.page.2: Shapeless from paper, an ink sac and a feather. Use it to open the note code editor; signing with
simplemusic.guide.page.3.title: Sheet Music
simplemusic.guide.page.3: a title makes it read-only, like a written book. A sheet holds either a composition or an uploaded track.
simplemusic.guide.page.4.title: Note code
simplemusic.guide.page.4: Text lines: "tempo 4" (ticks per step, 1-20), "$h = harp" or "$k = sound minecraft:entity.cat.ambient" (aliases), "$h: c4 e4 g4 - . [c4 e4]" (tracks).
simplemusic.guide.page.5.title: Editor
simplemusic.guide.page.5: Coloured code field with line numbers and underlined problems (the blueprint editor's field, now in SimpleLib). Listen plays the code on your client only.
simplemusic.guide.page.6.title: Import
simplemusic.guide.page.6: Put .txt note code or Note Block Studio .nbs files into config/simplemusic/sheets/ and pick one in the editor; the import only creates text.
simplemusic.guide.page.7.title: Copying at the cartography table
simplemusic.guide.page.7: Like a blueprint: a signed sheet on top, an empty sheet below gives a copy; only the empty sheet is used up.
simplemusic.guide.page.8.title: Orchestrion
simplemusic.guide.page.8: Two copper ingots beside a note block over a jukebox. Right-click with a sheet or a pressed disc (composition or
simplemusic.guide.page.9.title: Orchestrion
simplemusic.guide.page.9: track) to put it in, with an empty hand to take it out. It plays on a loop and never ejects.
simplemusic.guide.page.10.title: Redstone
simplemusic.guide.page.10: Signal on: plays and loops. Signal off: stops at the end of the current step. A rising edge starts from the top. Never wired: plays and loops.
simplemusic.guide.page.11.title: Playlist on top
simplemusic.guide.page.11: A chest, trapped chest, barrel or copper chest on top is the playlist: after each run the next
simplemusic.guide.page.12.title: Playlist on top
simplemusic.guide.page.12: sheet or custom disc swaps places with the finished one (slot order). Without another one the piece loops.
simplemusic.guide.page.13.title: Blank Disc
simplemusic.guide.page.13: Four coal or charcoal and four blackstone around an amethyst shard. The disc press presses the music of a sheet onto it.
simplemusic.guide.page.14.title: Disc Press
simplemusic.guide.page.14: A piston over two iron ingots over three smooth stone. Put a sheet of music on top and blank discs below: it presses the sheet's music (composition or uploaded track) onto a blank in 2 seconds. The sheet always stays.
simplemusic.guide.page.15.title: File check
simplemusic.guide.page.15: The server checks every upload itself without decoding: Ogg Vorbis only, one stream, intact pages (checksums), mono only, 22.05-48 kHz, at most 4 MiB and 5 minutes (server settings). Tags are removed.
simplemusic.guide.page.16.title: Custom Disc
simplemusic.guide.page.16: A pressed disc carries either an uploaded track (hash, title, length, uploader - never audio; amethyst label) or a composition (paper label). Both play in the Orchestrion (loop, playlist) and in the Vanilla jukebox (once);
simplemusic.guide.page.17.title: Custom Disc
simplemusic.guide.page.17: the Pocket Jukebox takes track discs.
simplemusic.guide.page.18.title: Pocket Jukebox
simplemusic.guide.page.18: A bundle for up to 20 discs (Vanilla discs and track discs). Use it in the main hand to play or pause; only you hear it, at full volume wherever you go.
simplemusic.guide.page.19.title: Moderation
simplemusic.guide.page.19: Everyone may upload up to 5 tracks; others hear a track only after an operator approves it, until then only the uploader. In single player and for the LAN host it is approved at once.
simplemusic.guide.page.20.title: Creative tabs
simplemusic.guide.page.20: The module's items sit in its own creative tab and next to the jukebox in Functional Blocks.
simplemusic.guide.page.21.title: Settings
simplemusic.guide.page.21: More settings are in the mod's config screen.
